title: Validate the DP learning spine and map foundations to modern DP-ML
question: Which single source best serves as a rigorous learning spine for differential privacy, what should be used if the format must literally be one paper, and what post-2014 concepts are required for modern DP/DP-ML literacy?
acceptance_criteria: Compare the non-technical primer, foundational article, comprehensive monograph, and modern DP-ML guide with primary-source evidence.
Separate conceptual accessibility, mathematical completeness, and modern practical coverage.
Map adjacency and the DP definition through sensitivity, mechanisms, composition, approximate DP, and modern accounting.
Red-team whether Dwork-Roth 2014 is too old to remain the foundational spine.
Identify the minimum modern supplement for DP-SGD/privacy-accounting literacy.
Create derivation-based mastery gates and bound unresolved uncertainty.
